title: File:Randy's donuts1 edit1.jpg
desc:
Randy's Donuts, colloquially known as "The Big O", is a donut shop in Los Angeles, California.
Made famous by the 32.5-foot (9.9 m) donut on its roof. The building opened in 1954. It is recognizable due to its many appearances in movies, music videos, and television.
Courtesy of the Historic America
